en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Uzafir, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The walking behind the coffin is superior than the walking in front of it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma’il from Muhammad ibn ‘Adhafir from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar, who has said the following: “Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Walking behind the coffin of the deceased is more virtuous than walking in front of it.’”
